concepts.name: 1 清晰彩色圖示
concepts.detail: Medium: contemporary hand-crafted flat raster illustration, bold clean rounded contours, large solid color areas, consistent dark ink-blue outline, a tiny flat offset shadow for a subtle game-menu button feeling. Mostly frontal, almost no perspective. Very simple, friendly and legible, no grain or texture, not 3D, not watercolor. Palette: deep ink #293B58, sky blue #70AEE0, fresh mint #83C4AC, muted coral #E58A73, warm ivory #FFF4DB. Main book is blue, quiz is mint with coral selection, papers ivory with blue chart, researcher figures coral and mint around an ink-blue desk. Outline is clearly visible on light and dark site themes, cream highlights only inside objects. Tight visual system, similar complexity across all four.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a new icon-design comparison sheet for an academic learning and research website.
Goal: instantly understandable everyday pictograms, with a SMALL amount of gaming personality. Clarity comes first. Avoid elaborate worldbuilding, symbolic puzzles, fantasy metaphors, classical arches, space stations, emblems, seals, decorative gold trim or leather fantasy books.
Composition: wide approximately 3:1 canvas, EXACTLY FOUR isolated navigation icon groups in ONE horizontal row, evenly spaced and same visual weight. Each group stays entirely within its own quarter, all edges fully visible, with comfortable clear gaps. Design as if displayed at only 80–96px per icon: one main recognizable silhouette, at most one supporting cue, large simple shapes, minimal detail.
LEFT / course notes: a familiar open textbook or academic notebook with a clearly visible page spread, chapter tab/bookmark and a few simple text-line marks. No geometric triangles or mystical designs on pages.
SECOND / interactive learning: a question card with one large legible ? above two simple answer rows, one answer row selected by an obvious pointing hand cursor or a filled selection circle. A recognizable quiz interaction, not a game controller.
THIRD / research publications: two slightly offset scholarly paper sheets, front page with three short abstract line marks and one prominent simple plotted chart with axes; no magnifying glass, medals, stars or checkmark. It should read as academic papers/report, not file search.
RIGHT / research lab community: two simple adult researcher figures seated on opposite sides of one compact shared desk, with a single computer monitor between them; plain academic clothing, neutral figures with no detailed facial features. The people and shared work must be recognizable at a glance. No lab coats, chemistry glassware, building or tiny whole-room scene.
Do not add any text or letters except the single ? on the quiz card. No labels, numbers, logos or watermark. Keep the academic intent obvious and the emotional tone welcoming, mature, quietly playful.
Genuinely transparent alpha background around and between every icon group. No background tiles, panels, enclosing badges, full-canvas color, checkerboard, glow, halo, stray flecks or outer paper fringe. Clear cutout edges.

Palette: deep ink #293B58, sky blue #70AEE0, fresh mint #83C4AC, muted coral #E58A73, warm ivory #FFF4DB. Outline is clearly visible on light and dark site themes, cream highlights only inside objects. Tight visual system, similar complexity across all four.

concepts.name: 2 漫畫學者道具
concepts.detail: Medium: crisp cel-shaded 2D game-inventory illustration, strong simplified silhouettes, lively yet restrained three-quarter view, confident dark contour line and only two levels of shadow. Modern academic tools, no fantasy ornamentation. Palette: rich teal #287D83, warm orange #E9A04E, tomato coral #D86657, soft oatmeal #F6E6C8, dark charcoal-teal #243C42. The course book has a simple chunky orange bookmark; quiz card selected row has a clear large orange hand pointer; academic paper chart is teal; two researchers wear coral and teal, working across a small orange-and-charcoal desk. Keep linework disciplined, details sparse and the scene compact. No distressed texture or parchment.

concepts.name: 3 16-bit 學習冒險
concepts.detail: Medium: clean expertly crafted 16-bit pixel-art inventory icons with a disciplined visible square-pixel grid, crisp stepped edges, no smoothing, no blur, no outlines thinner than one conceptual pixel. Slight frontal three-quarter view, restrained two-tone pixel shading, simple large silhouette. Each icon concept uses a compact approximately 64x64 logical pixel grid. Palette: midnight ink #26384F, cornflower #718FD3, pale aqua #8DD6C8, warm apricot #F0AF70, off-white #F7F0DD, small muted raspberry #BB6078 accents. Book blue with an apricot bookmark; quiz cream with clear pixel ? and aqua selected row; papers cream with a blue bar/line chart; two compact adult pixel characters working around one shared monitor and desk. The ? is the only character. No XP bars, ratings, badges, coins, health meters, RPG weapons or text.

concepts.name: 4 俐落雙色線條
concepts.detail: Medium: elegant clear editorial monoline pictograms with selective solid fills, thick uniform rounded ink strokes and broad open negative space. Flat frontal view. A small clipped-corner tab, one square selection marker and a few blocky stepped accents give a subtle strategy-game interface feeling without ornaments. High readability, mature academic utility icons. Palette: deep plum ink #4B3D61, soft lilac #B7ACD4, amber #E9AD4F, warm white #FFF5E5. Use plum outlines for all four icons, lilac fills for book covers and people shirts, amber reserved for bookmark, selected answer, plotted line and monitor. White interiors belong only to objects, surrounding space remains transparent. Outline roughly 5% of each icon width, not fragile hairlines. No faux 3D, no watercolor, no filled background badges, no shadows.

concepts.name: 5 桌遊立體件
concepts.detail: Medium: clean premium miniature 3D board-game learning tools, shallow sculpted forms with rounded edges, matte enamel and soft-touch material, no ornate details. Mostly frontal with slight three-quarter perspective, controlled soft studio lighting, compact solid construction. Palette: deep petrol-teal #2A6670, warm brick-coral #D57963, pale sage #B2C7B0, warm ceramic white #F7EFE0, graphite #303D45. Four instantly recognizable literal icons: open ceramic-white textbook with petrol cover and thick coral bookmark; upright white quiz card with one large teal ? and two broad rounded answer rows, a coral pointing hand touching one row; two stacked white paper forms with a very clear raised teal chart/axes on the front, sparse short lines; two small plainly dressed adult researcher figurines in coral and sage sitting across a compact teal desk sharing one laptop. People are contemporary researchers, not robots, soldiers or children. Each icon should feel like a nicely made piece in an educational board game. No framing discs, collectible bases, pedestals, badges or background tiles. No plastic gloss, glow, metallic gold, textures or detailed tiny props. Keep all icons equally readable and simple.

concepts.cleanupPrompt: Use case: background-extraction. The input is the EDIT TARGET. Remove all pale/white fuzzy halo, gray shadow haze, fringe and stray specks OUTSIDE the four actual solid icon silhouettes. Make all empty surrounding areas and the gaps between the four icons genuinely fully transparent. The current stray halo is especially strong around the quiz card and paper stack; it must disappear. Preserve the exact original icon shapes, interiors, materials, colors, positions, sizes, order and horizontal canvas. Do not alter the cream book pages or cream card/paper surfaces that belong INSIDE the solid icons. Keep only crisp anti-aliased silhouette edges, no shadow outside the objects. No new background, no white outline, no checkerboard, no labels, no redraw, no additions. Retain all four icons intact and fully visible.
